name: Plan, build, verify
description: Plan, wait for approval, build, run the plan's criteria checks, judge the criteria without a check in a fresh context and send the failures back to the builder until it passes, then review the diff once in a fresh context. The human reads the findings and picks what the builder fixes; the criteria checks run again after the fix, with no second review.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.prompt:
{{task}}

Frame the work with the human before planning: discuss it in the conversation until they agree on the approach, unless it is a small change with one obvious way to do it. Then end by calling propose_plan with the complete plan, even if you gave it earlier in this conversation: the next steps read only your last message.
